items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: And last summer in Nice, Harry Edison spoke to me about it.

ctx.x: Before. Then he sent me a card from Africa saying, I don't know how to thank you, everything is going great. And I felt so good about it. And last summer in Nice, Harry Edison spoke to me about it. I heard Harry Edison and I said, what's wrong with you? And he said, well, I just heard a lot about you from Jonah and Buck Clayton, maybe
you can help me. I said, you don't sound like you need any help, you sound all right to me. And we never had a chance to get together.
